verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs mention Jira issue integration (auto status updates on commit, built-in Jira UI in Bitbucket, opening Jira tickets from PRs) which covers basic issue tracking, but this relies entirely on a separate Jira product rather than native Bitbucket issue features, and there is no mention of milestones, time tracking, or dependency tracking anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: native milestone support, time tracking, dependency linking, and evidence these work without requiring a separate Jira subscription.
